He's the avatar of the Arzinian of Bordanzan. This being was created with one goal in mind - that of protection and it doesn't hold any conflicting emotions or agendas so fights with true determination.

Quest: Between a Rock

Combat: This holy avatar will fight you using fire-based magic. This time around the amount of gold ore you're carrying won't make a difference. It's on the tower's terms and not his!
